bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
python3 scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py --chat-id -1002373696859 --topic-id 1605 >/tmp/video-topic-userbot-final.out 2>/tmp/video-topic-userbot-final.err || exit 71
python3 scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py --chat-id -1003770334893 --topic-id 4 >/tmp/gay-topic-userbot-final.out 2>/tmp/gay-topic-userbot-final.err || exit 72
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys
for path,topic in [('/tmp/video-topic-userbot-final.out',1605),('/tmp/gay-topic-userbot-final.out',4)]:
 line=next((x for x in pathlib.Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=')),None)
 if not line:sys.exit(73)
 doc=json.loads(line.split('=',1)[1])
 rows=doc.get('rows') or []
 if doc.get('status')!='PASS' or len(rows)!=1 or rows[0].get('topic_id')!=topic:sys.exit(74)
 row=rows[0]
 if row.get('pin_state')!='PRESENT':sys.exit(75 if topic==1605 else 76)
 if 'normal' not in row.get('button_types',[]):sys.exit(77 if topic==1605 else 78)
 if 'INTERNAL_CALLBACK' not in row.get('pin_transports',[]):sys.exit(79 if topic==1605 else 80)
print('BOTH_TOPIC_USERBOT_PIN_CALLBACKS=PASS')
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 82
